windblown.options.title: Windblown
windblown.options.enabled.tooltip: Grass, flowers, crops, leaves and vines sway in the wind, and plants rustle when you walk through them.
windblown.options.strength.tooltip: How far plants sway. 100% is a light breeze; storms blow harder on top of this.
windblown.options.gusts.tooltip: How much the wind rises and falls in gusts. 0% gives a steady, constant breeze.
windblown.options.grass.tooltip: Grass, ferns, flowers, saplings, bushes and other small plants.
windblown.options.crops.tooltip: Wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, stems and other crops. They sway a little stiffer.
windblown.options.leaves.tooltip: Tree leaves shiver and drift in the wind.
windblown.options.vines.tooltip: Vines on walls, hanging roots, moss and vines that hang from ceilings.
windblown.options.water_plants.tooltip: Seagrass and kelp drift slowly in the current.
windblown.options.weather.tooltip: Rain makes the wind pick up, thunderstorms even more.
windblown.options.rustle.tooltip: Grass, crops and leaves rustle when you, other players or mobs move through them.
windblown.options.reset.tooltip: Put every Windblown setting back to how it started.
